system.description:
Usage held in 1 hand; Weight 2 lbs. Power Points 10; Recharge 1 per day.

The ivory shaft divides near its head into two carved hands, one supporting the other.

Activate You cast a spell with the Healing trait that restores HP.

Action Free

Expend 1 PP from the rod. After resolving the spell normally, select one creature that regained HP from it. That creature regains an additional 1d8 HP.

A creature may receive this additional healing only once from a single spell regardless of other abilities affecting it.

On the sheet: held, after a Healing spell restores HP the rod offers 1 PP for +1d8 to one creature it healed.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
